what: Pressing the button opens a dropdown menu 8px below it, centered, growing from 0 in 0.3s (anchored at top center). On close it keeps its size and fades out in 0.1s. A branch menu opens attached to the right when you hover a row, and closes on an outside click or Esc. If it hits the screen edge, it opens pushed 12px inward

options.[data-fx-part=sub]: Branch menu row — first child is the row, second is [data-fx-part=pop]
options.--fx-out: Fade-out duration on close (via style), default .1s — in the original it does not shrink on close

from.where: index.html menu bar .ap-menu (File · Edit · Tools · Info) · submenus of the Tools menu (mountain size · building type)
